nodes.label: LLM Wrapper
nodes.rationale: Centralizes model access, timeout, retry, fallback, and structured JSON policy.

nodes.label: Evaluation-First Design
nodes.rationale: Makes agent behavior measurable, comparable, and improvable through shared evaluation utilities and standardized contracts.

nodes.label: NL2SQL Security Boundary
nodes.rationale: Treats LLM-generated SQL as untrusted and validates it before bounded execution with external access disabled.

nodes.label: Bring Your Own Key
nodes.rationale: Provider keys are held only in browser memory for the current page session and sent per request.

nodes.label: Bounded Revision Loop
nodes.rationale: MAX_REVISIONS prevents infinite loops while allowing the writer to continue with the best available findings.
